The service is free to users and monetized through non-intrusive advertising. Playbite is a consumer-facing mobile gaming product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures its company identity, public web properties, and domain security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Promolta
providers.description: Promolta is a self-service video advertising platform that promotes YouTube and other videos across a network of blogs, websites, mobile apps, and social networks to grow views, subscribers, and engagement. Advertisers fund campaigns and target audiences, while publishers in the Promolta network earn by distributing sponsored video content. Promolta is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or webhook surface — this profile captures its public web, legal, and domain-security footprint.

providers.name: Velocia
providers.description: Velocia is a transit ridership solutions company that uses real-time rewards, incentives, and digital tools to increase public-transit ridership and engagement for transit agencies and cities. Its programs include a Rider Incentive Program, Transit Ambassador Program, Mobility Wallet, rider surveys, an Automated Guaranteed Ride Home Program, and Major Event Solutions, integrated into transit apps to drive behavior change. Velocia partners with agencies and mobility services such as Miami-Dade County, King County Metro, Seattle DOT, Lime, Zipcar, Uber, Lyft, and CitiBike Miami. Founded in 2018 and based in Toronto, Velocia is a Techstars-backed company. This profile has no public developer/API surface at enrichment time.

providers.name: Awfar Market
providers.description: Awfar is a Cairo- and Riyadh-based digital solutions company (founded 2013) offering an integrated customer engagement and commerce platform. It combines an omnichannel Chat Center with AI agents (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook), a cloud Call Center, and a Commerce & Delivery platform for order, inventory, and logistics management within a single interface. Awfar serves more than 2,000 clients across retail, pharmacy, restaurant, e-commerce, tourism, healthcare, education, and real estate, and ships prebuilt integrations for Shopify, Meta, Odoo, Zid, and Salla plus custom API connections. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specification is published at this time; integration is arranged via the sales and demo channel.

providers.name: BlueOcean
providers.description: BlueOcean is a Context AI platform purpose-built for marketing teams. Its agentic AI framework, Spark, combines brand, market, product, and customer context to help marketers unlock creativity, accelerate go-to-market, and deliver measurable impact — automating work from strategy through content creation, competitive intelligence, brand performance analytics, and reporting. The platform surfaces evidence-grounded recommendations across brand, product marketing, and content, and is used by enterprise marketing teams at companies such as SAP, AWS, and Cisco. BlueOcean is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Broadlume
providers.description: Broadlume is an all-in-one business platform for the flooring industry, serving more than 4,000 retailers and 300+ manufacturers. Its products span lead-generating websites, digital advertising, SEO and reputation management, product catalogs, and a suite of flooring business software covering accounting, inventory management, job costing, and lead management, plus a retail selling system with in-store visualization and e-commerce sample ordering. Broadlume is owned by Cyncly. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network and tracks Broadlume's public web and security surface.

providers.name: Fold
providers.description: Fold (NASDAQ: FLD) is a bitcoin financial services company founded in 2014 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, billed as the first publicly traded bitcoin financial services company. Fold makes it easy for individuals and businesses to earn, save, and use bitcoin through consumer products including the Fold App, the Fold Bitcoin Rewards Credit Card, the Fold Debit Card, and the Fold Bitcoin Gift Card marketplace, paying real bitcoin rewards (not points or a proprietary token) on everyday purchases and bill payments. Bitcoin custody and Lightning Network payouts are powered by partners such as BitGo and OpenNode. Fold is a consumer-facing fintech application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Paramark
providers.description: Paramark is a marketing measurement and forecasting platform that helps growth and finance teams understand the true incremental impact of their marketing spend. Founded in 2022 by Pranav Piyush and Pete Belknap and backed by Greylock, Paramark combines incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and scenario planning in one place, augmented by human growth advisors and AI agents. Rather than relying on last-touch attribution, the platform uses statistics and machine learning to quantify each channel's incremental contribution across search, social, TV, and out-of-home, giving marketers defensible ROI numbers to bring to their finance teams. Paramark maintains an open-source Marketing Mix Modeling workbench and forks of the major MMM libraries under its paramark-inc GitHub organization. Paramark does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; API access is offered as a feature of its Advanced commercial tier.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: BuzzFeed
providers.description: BuzzFeed Inc. is a digital media company founded in 2006 and headquartered in New York City, best known for its viral entertainment, quizzes, pop-culture coverage, and commerce content. The company operates a portfolio of brands including the flagship BuzzFeed site, the news operation HuffPost, and the food brand Tasty, and produces video, podcasts, and shoppable content across web and social platforms. BuzzFeed is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: BZFD) and monetizes through advertising, brand partnerships, and commerce. It does not publish a general-purpose public developer API program; its public machine-readable surface consists of content syndication (RSS feeds), an advertising/partnerships business, and a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program via HackerOne. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from an a16z portfolio lead and enriched with the provider's real public surface.

providers.name: Truex Media
providers.description: TrueX (stylized true[X]) is an interactive, opt-in video advertising company now operating as part of Infillion. Its technology delivers "attention-based" ad experiences — Choice Cards and interactive engagement units that let viewers opt in to a single, longer branded interaction in exchange for an ad-free content break — across connected TV (CTV), over-the-top (OTT), mobile, and web. The company originated as SocialVibe (a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company), was acquired by 21st Century Fox, and is now a video advertising product within Infillion alongside MediaMath, InStadium, Gimbal, and Catalina. TrueX's integration surface is the TruexAdRenderer (TAR) client SDK — published first-party from the "socialvibe" GitHub organization for iOS, tvOS, Android, Roku, and CTV/HTML5 web via Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods — rather than a public REST API. Publishers embed the renderer, typically alongside Google IMA (client- or server-side ad insertion), to serve and measure interactive ads.

providers.name: ATOM
providers.description: Atom (atomchat.io) is a Panama-based conversational-commerce platform whose multimodal AI Agents combine text, voice, image, and CRM data to run human-like WhatsApp conversations that qualify leads and close sales for businesses across Latin America. Founded in 2019 by Erick Holmann and Rene Mouynes and backed by Techstars and Mucker Capital, Atom connects WhatsApp click-to-chat ads to an AI agent that engages and qualifies prospects, then hands sales-ready leads to human reps. It exposes a Customers API and a WhatsApp template-message API, both authenticated with an account API key configured from the Atom admin panel.

providers.name: Clickable
providers.description: Clickable is a marketing analytics and digital advertising platform founded in 2006 that serves as an ads and analytics partner for businesses and agencies. The company builds award-winning pay-per-click (PPC) advertising tools for search and social campaigns and delivers customized reporting that cuts through data overload so marketers can focus on the metrics that matter. Clickable also offers VIN retention reporting purpose-built for automotive dealerships to improve customer retention. Backed by Union Square Ventures, the company focuses on relationship-driven managed advertising and analytics services rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Cooleaf
providers.description: Cooleaf is an employee engagement, recognition, and rewards platform built by ITA Group that helps HR and people leaders create lasting engagement across their organizations. The platform lets teams recognize peers, reward performance and KPIs, celebrate milestones and anniversaries, run pulse surveys and challenges, deliver training and programming, and surface engagement analytics through manager dashboards. Cooleaf meets employees where they already work by embedding recognition into Slack and Microsoft Teams and syncing people data through connectors like Zapier and Workday. Cooleaf is delivered as a closed SaaS product with a hosted web application and login; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and the integration surface it exposes to customers rather than a developer program.

providers.name: GoAudience
providers.description: GoAudience is a customer-intelligence platform for Shopify ecommerce brands that turns first-party customer data into marketing decisions. It builds stable customer personas from real store data, surfaces findings and recommended actions ranked by impact, and syncs directly into Klaviyo, Meta, TikTok and other marketing tools. Features include a natural-language command surface for asking grounded questions about customers, a weekly "Monday Brief" digest of at-risk, lapsed and recovered customers with revenue impact, and a 90-day email audit. GoAudience is a Techstars-backed company; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Indigov
providers.description: Indigov is a constituent relationship management (CRM) platform purpose-built for government — U.S. Congressional offices, state legislatures, and municipal agencies — that unifies inbound constituent communications from email, web forms, SMS, social media, phone, and scanned mail into a single cross-organizational inbox. It layers casework tracking, constituent routing, smart tagging, and mass-email triage with rapid response, plus a customer data platform for sentiment and engagement analytics and an award-winning mobile app for field staff. Indigov serves government offices across 35 states and 2 territories and was acquired by Granicus, joining its Government Experience Cloud (GXC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Aktana (PharmaForceIQ)
providers.description: Aktana is an AI-driven commercial engagement platform for the pharmaceutical and life-sciences industry, now operating as PharmaForceIQ (aktana.com redirects in full to pharmaforceiq.com). The platform provides real-time orchestration that coordinates digital and field marketing across channels ("optichannel") to drive measurable script lift and HCP (healthcare provider) adoption, with NPI-level dashboards tying engagement to outcomes for HCP marketing, DTC marketing, medical affairs, omnichannel, sales, and commercial-leadership teams. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer/API surface; this profile captures corporate identity, compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR), and web properties.

providers.name: Bevz
providers.description: Bevz is a delivery-management platform built for liquor stores and convenience retailers that consolidates multiple third-party delivery apps (DoorDash, Uber Eats, GrubHub) into a single dashboard. Its products cover menu management across platforms (Connect), AI-powered marketing and local promotion on Yelp, Google, and Facebook (Reach), cross-platform performance analytics (Reporting+), and a white-label direct-delivery storefront for restricted items (Shop.Bevz). Bevz bundles an iPad plus software, access to a 215,000+ product catalog, barcode scanning, onboarding, and training. Bevz is a Techstars-backed company; no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are currently published, so this profile is identity-only pending an API surface.

providers.name: Dealpad
providers.description: Dealpad is an AI-powered buyer-enablement and digital-sales-room platform for B2B sales teams. It centralizes the buyer and seller relationship into shared digital sales rooms, mutual action plans, and curated content, then layers "Sales Mind AI" predictive insight over each opportunity to help sellers progress complex, multi-stakeholder deals faster. Dealpad integrates with major CRMs including Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho, and targets sales leaders, account executives, and enterprise revenue teams. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Dealpad does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: Influenxio
providers.description: Influenxio is an Instagram influencer-marketing platform that connects brands with a database of more than 500,000 influencer profiles through an AI-powered matching system. Brands use its campaign-management tooling to search, invite, and collaborate with influencers at scale for brand awareness, website traffic, and affiliate marketing, including a pay-per-click affiliate model and content-authorization workflows for reusing user-generated content. It is a B2B SaaS product aimed at marketers and brands rather than developers, and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: NeoTaste
providers.description: NeoTaste is a restaurant discovery and dining-deals mobile app operated by NeoTaste GmbH (Osnabrück, Germany). Under the tagline "Discover more. Pay less." it surfaces curated local restaurants and exclusive member deals such as 2-for-1 main courses and a free starter with a main, letting diners try new places while saving money and helping restaurants attract new guests. The consumer product ships as native iOS and Android apps and currently operates across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. NeoTaste is a venture-backed (Series A) company surfaced through the Earlybird portfolio. It exposes no public developer API — its api.neotaste.com backend is a private, authentication-gated service for the first-party mobile apps — so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an integration surface.

providers.name: Robby
providers.description: Robby is an AI-powered growth and job-documentation platform for home-services businesses, focused on HVAC contractors. It automates job documentation and paperwork for technicians so they can focus on servicing equipment and talking to customers, combines customer and third-party data to surface new leads daily, equips technicians with talking points to increase sales, and gives management a dashboard to monitor the revenue opportunities captured from every visit. Robby is an early-stage Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup that currently publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Shoelace
providers.description: Shoelace is an omni-channel growth marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands, trusted by 300+ brands. The team plans, creates, and optimizes paid advertising, email, and creative work across both acquisition and retention channels to drive real, measurable revenue growth. Shoelace operates as a managed growth partner delivering marketing services rather than a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a 500 Global portfolio lead and captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: soona
providers.description: soona is an all-in-one creative platform for ecommerce brands that produces and manages product photography, video, and user-generated content (UGC). Brands can book virtual and in-studio photo and video shoots with vetted models, stylists, and photographers; generate on-brand content at scale with soona AI Studio; organize assets in a digital asset manager (DAM); and analyze listing performance and competitors with Listing Insights across Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, Meta, and TikTok. soona is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures, techstars, and union-square-ventures; enrichment found no public developer API or documentation surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Spotwise, Inc.
providers.description: Spotwise is an agentic operating system for broadcast media that detects advertising across radio, TV, podcasts, and streaming audio in real time, converts that ad-play data into qualified sales leads with decision-maker enrichment, and automates the outreach and CRM workflows that sell against it. Built by broadcasters and backed by 500 Global, the platform packages products including Spotwise aOS, the Spotty conversational copilot, Spotwise Intelligence, Lead-list, Contact Finder, Monitors & Signals, and Skills for ad-sales and commercial-leadership teams across 13 countries. Spotwise is a closed SaaS product accessed through app.spotwise.ai; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Blackbird Labs Inc
providers.description: Blackbird Labs is the company behind Blackbird, a payments-and-loyalty app for the restaurant industry. Diners earn status, perks, points, and the $FLY rewards token by checking in and paying at partner restaurants, while restaurants gain a direct guest relationship and improved economics. Settlement runs on Flynet, a layer-three protocol built on Coinbase's Base blockchain. Founded by Resy and Eater co-founder Ben Leventhal, Blackbird is live across cities including New York, San Francisco, Charleston, Denver, and New Orleans, and raised $50 million in 2025. Backed by investors including QED Investors and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z crypto). Blackbird is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company and security posture surface.

providers.name: A Place for Mom
providers.description: A Place for Mom is North America's largest senior living referral service, connecting families with assisted living, memory care, independent living, home care, and other senior care options through a network of Senior Living Advisors and a large marketplace of care communities. Families use the service at no cost to search, compare, and get matched to providers, while care communities and home care agencies partner with A Place for Mom to receive and manage referral leads, respond to and moderate consumer reviews, and track billing and performance through provider-facing portals. A Place for Mom was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company operates consumer-facing web properties plus provider, community-partner, reputation, and home care portals, and publishes a support knowledge base (including an llms.txt documentation index) rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: AiSensum
providers.description: AiSensum (AISensum) builds agentic AI "teammates" that work alongside front-line staff to drive revenue, improve quality, and reduce labour while keeping the human in the lead. Operating since 2017 with a presence across Southeast Asia, it deploys purpose-built AI teammates for enterprise front-line operations in retail, F&B, hospitality and entertainment, each specialising in one measurable outcome: Daniel (revenue teammate, personalised counter offers/upsell), Sasha (time and cost teammate, bulk product-photo editing and approval), and Nicole (progress teammate, conversation scoring and cashier coaching against brand SOPs). Deployments are scoped through a half-day IFA (Intelligent Front-line Automation) Workshop. AiSensum publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; it is a portfolio company of 500 Global tracked in the API Evangelist network. This profile was enriched from the company's public web presence and an on-site llms.txt.

providers.name: Kuli
providers.description: Kuli is an AI agent for influencer marketing, built for consumer brands. It runs the full creator marketing lifecycle end to end — discovery, vetting, outreach, and reporting — so a small marketing team ships like a much larger one. Unlike platforms that filter creators on metadata such as follower counts and engagement rates, Kuli's agent watches actual creator videos frame by frame across TikTok and Instagram, assessing brand safety, content style, audience signals, and brand fit, then drafts personalized outreach in the brand's own voice and reports campaign ROI on a schedule. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Levallois-Perret, Paris, Kuli is a Y Combinator company. As of this profile Kuli publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs — its only machine-readable surface is an llms.txt.

providers.name: Lil Snack
providers.description: Lil Snack is a Manhattan Beach, California games company, founded in 2024, that builds "snackable" daily games and party games — short pop-culture puzzle, word, and trivia titles that refresh every day. It runs its own consumer destination at lilsnack.com (Clue Daily, Scattergories Daily, Swap, DownWords, Pickle, Lite Brite Daily, Wheel of Fortune TODAY, Quiz Climb, Venn, Chain, and more) and also powers games embedded inside partner consumer platforms, citing BuzzFeed, FOX, Hasbro, the Los Angeles Times, Netflix, Peacock, Prime Gaming, Reddit, and Sony. The company reports 40M+ games played and 10M+ players all-time, and monetizes through platform partnerships, sponsorships, and brand licensing. As of this profile Lil Snack publishes NO public developer surface — no API, no documentation portal, no SDKs, no public GitHub organization, and no /.well-known documents; its partner game integrations are arranged through business development rather than self-serve APIs. This API Evangelist profile therefore captures verified company identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: RankScience
providers.description: RankScience is a San Francisco based SEO and AI-visibility agency (RankScience LLC) that helps startups, SaaS companies, and enterprises grow search traffic through foundational and technical SEO, strategic content, and link building, alongside next-generation AI-search optimization services (Generative Engine Optimization, Large Language Model Optimization, and Answer Engine Optimization) for platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. It began as a YC-backed SEO A/B testing platform and now operates as a services agency. RankScience does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web and AI-discovery surface (a published /llms.txt and domain security posture).

providers.name: Total Attorneys (Internet Brands)
providers.description: Total Attorneys is a legal marketing and lead-generation brand owned by Internet Brands. Originally a legal practice-management and client-intake SaaS backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the service was folded into the Martindale-Avvo network, and as of April 1, 2019 its attorney lead-generation offering transitioned to the Martindale-Nolo Pay Per Lead program. The totalattorneys.com site today markets pay-per-lead attorney marketing across practice areas such as bankruptcy, criminal defense, DUI/DWI, divorce, and personal injury. No public developer program or API is currently published.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: alphin
providers.description: alphin is a Berlin-based marketing platform for local small businesses, giving restaurants, cafes, salons, and similar SMBs an all-in-one app to manage and automate their online presence. Its product suite spans review collection (alphin Reviews), Instagram and social management (alphin Socials), professional photography (alphin Photos), local influencer marketing (alphin Local Influencers), targeted Instagram advertising (alphin Local Ads), and multi-platform profile management across Google, TripAdvisor, and Yelp (alphin Portals), consolidated into one dashboard with daily reporting and analytics. Founded in 2016 (as Freachly GmbH), alphin serves 1,000+ local businesses across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Israel, and is backed by HV Capital, Partech, Scale Capital, and Wille Finance. alphin publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; the product is delivered through its web and mobile Business App.

providers.name: Anonym
providers.description: Anonym is a privacy-preserving advertising technology platform now operated by Mozilla, sitting between advertisers and major publishers to measure and optimize ad performance without exposing individual user data. It uses confidential computing and privacy-enhancing techniques to run performance measurement and campaign optimization across platforms including TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Reddit, replacing costly custom data-sharing systems with a single privacy-compliant setup. Anonym was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; its public surface is a marketing site (anonymco.com, redirecting to mozilla.org/anonym) and a customer login portal (anonymportal.com). No public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Gomultiply
providers.description: Multiply (gomultiply.com) is an AI-native paid media agency for B2B companies that combines proprietary self-learning advertising AI with human growth strategists. The platform plugs into a customer's sales calls and CRM data to learn why buyers actually convert, then uses 25+ specialized AI agents (customer insights, keyword, creative design, A/B testing, bidding, and attribution) to generate, launch, and continuously optimize hundreds of personalized ad experiments across Google and LinkedIn. Founded by Matt Jayson (formerly Google and Brex) and Ashish Warty (formerly SVP Engineering at HackerOne, Dropbox, and Airship), Multiply emerged from stealth with $9.5M led by Mayfield and reports 300-500% increases in sales meetings booked and pipeline generated for its B2B customers.

providers.name: Qeen.AI
providers.description: Qeen.AI is an AI-powered digital marketing ecosystem for e-commerce brands across the GCC and wider MENA region. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in the UAE, the company pairs machine learning with human marketing expertise to run strategy, paid-media execution, creative production, and continuous optimization on a performance basis (no retainers, commission starting at 5% of generated revenue). Its founding team includes former Google and DeepMind researchers, and it has raised roughly $12M, including backing from Prosus Ventures. Qeen.AI operates a customer application at app.qeen.ai but does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: RB2B
providers.description: RB2B is a US-focused B2B website visitor identification platform that resolves anonymous web traffic into person-level leads — names, LinkedIn profiles, hashed and plaintext business emails, mobile ad IDs, and full business profiles — and pushes them to sales, marketing, and ad-tech systems. The product is delivered as a JavaScript pixel plus a knowledge- base and pipeline of 50+ destination integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, Apollo, Customer.io, Demandbase, and others), with global company-level identification and US-only person- level resolution. RB2B operates a separate API Partner Program at api.rb2b.com that exposes credit-metered Identification endpoints (IP → HEM, IP → MAID, IP → Company Domain) and Enrichment endpoints (HEM → LinkedIn, HEM → Business Profile, HEM → MAID, LinkedIn → Email, LinkedIn → Phone, Email → LinkedIn, Email → MAID) for SaaS developers, GTM engineers, retailers, and ad-tech platforms that want to embed identity resolution into their own apps and identity graphs. The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: SambaTV
providers.description: Samba TV is a media and advertising intelligence company that measures television and streaming viewership across screens using data collected from millions of opted-in smart TVs and connected devices. Its platform gives advertisers, agencies, and publishers cross-screen audience targeting, campaign measurement, and content analytics built on privacy-first, deterministic viewing signals rather than cookies or traditional identifiers. Samba TV operates a gated partner portal (developer.samba.tv, which redirects to partner-portal.tvp.samba.tv) for licensed data partners; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish an open, public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Scalarr
providers.description: Scalarr is an AI-powered cybersecurity company that builds machine-learning and neural-network detection systems to protect businesses from fraud and cyber threats in real time. Its Protection Suite detects and blocks mobile ad fraud on behalf of user-acquisition teams and mobile marketers, distinguishing fraudulent installs and in-app events from genuine ones, while its AI EdgeLabs product extends the same detection approach to edge and IoT cybersecurity. Scalarr is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and product pages but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Sensors Data
providers.description: Sensors Data (神策数据) is a customer data analytics and CDP (Customer Data Platform) company. Its platform unifies customer data across channels into real-time customer profiles and provides product analytics, user profiling, marketing and ad attribution, A/B testing, and smart-operations tooling. Sensors Data processes 250+ billion data points daily, ships 50+ data-collection SDKs across web, mobile, mini-program and server-side languages, and serves 2,000+ enterprise customers with both cloud and on-premise deployment. An OpenAPI is exposed for ecosystem integration.

providers.name: Sentisis Analytics
providers.description: Sentisis (Sentisis Intelligence) is a Spanish-language AI consumer-intelligence and sentiment-analysis platform that turns social media conversations, surveys, emails, and online reviews into actionable business insight using proprietary natural-language-processing built for Spanish and its regional variants. Products span Social Media listening, Customer Experience analytics, Reviews analysis, and sector consulting, serving brands such as Vodafone, Santander, Bancolombia, ALDI, Iberdrola, and Sony Pictures from offices in Madrid, Bogota, and Mexico City. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a domain security probe.

providers.name: Stitch Fix
providers.description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data science and machine learning with expert human stylists to send customers curated shipments ("Fixes") of apparel, footwear, and accessories selected to their size, budget, and style preferences. Founded in 2011 and publicly traded (NASDAQ: SFIX), the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail model across womens, mens, and kids categories. Stitch Fix does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its engineering team shares its data-science and platform work through the Multithreaded technology blog and open-source projects on GitHub. This profile captures the company's public web, security, and engineering surfaces.

providers.name: SylloTips
providers.description: SylloTips is an enterprise AI platform, founded in Italy and backed by Techstars, that adds a continuous-improvement and reliability layer on top of RAG chatbots and planning agents. It captures a company's undocumented, expert knowledge through human-in-the-loop validation, turns validated expert answers into governed, reusable memory, and monitors AI agents for silent failures — confidently wrong answers, outdated citations, and unadmitted knowledge gaps — routing issues to the right experts. The platform is optimized for Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise identity, ships native connectors to existing tools and data systems, and integrates with 200+ apps via Zapier, AWS, and Pabbly Connect. SylloTips publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration is delivered through those connectors and its Microsoft 365 / Teams application rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Avarra
providers.description: Avarra is an AI-powered sales training and enablement platform that helps revenue teams onboard, coach, and certify sales representatives at scale. The platform turns real sales conversations into AI-driven role-play simulations, delivers personalized coaching feedback, standardizes sales methodology across teams and regions, and reports certification and performance analytics. Its workflow moves through five stages: Capture, Train, Practice, Certify, and Performance Insights, with the stated goal of cutting new-hire ramp time in half. Avarra is a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company. As of this profile Avarra publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Local Holdings Limited
providers.description: Local (uselocal.co) is a Gulf Cooperation Council fintech and hospitality-technology company that replaces traditional card terminals with a single QR code guests scan to pay, order, and earn loyalty points instantly. Its pay-at-table, checkout, and remote payment-link flows serve 200+ restaurants, hotels, and hospitals across Bahrain, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, capturing customer profiles from each transaction and feeding real-time revenue, table-turn, and staff-performance analytics back to venues. Local integrates with regional payment methods (BenefitPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards) and POS platforms including Odoo, Oracle, Lightspeed, Square, and Invo. Local Holdings Limited was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Newton Research
providers.description: Newton Research builds a team of specially trained AI agents for marketing analytics. Pre-built or custom agents connect to a customer's existing data infrastructure, write and execute code, and automate analytics workflows — data exploration and preparation, audience management, Customer 360, planning and activation, cross-channel measurement and attribution, anomaly detection, yield management, and automated reporting — with data remaining on the customer's own instance. Founded by John Hoctor, Matthew Emans, and Steven Bennett, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Newton states SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliance. No public developer API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Payment24
providers.description: Payment24 is a white-label payment platform specializing in fuel and fleet payment solutions for oil companies, banks, and retailers, primarily across Africa. Its technology lets clients design and launch branded payment products under their own name — fuel payments and mobile payments, loyalty and rewards, POS terminals, electronic vouchers, B2B and B2C prepaid and store-account cards, EV charging payments, and wet-stock and fuel-in-tank management — alongside banking-grade issuing, acquiring, card management, and merchant management, plus fleet fuel management and telematics. Payment24 operates as a technology partner rather than a public self-serve API provider, so it publishes no open developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Yonder
providers.description: Yonder is a UK-based financial technology company offering rewards credit and debit cards — a "financial membership" that earns points on everyday spending, redeemable across 300+ dining, travel, shopping, entertainment and wellness partners. Cards run on the Mastercard network with no foreign-exchange fees, and Yonder is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) with FSCS-protected accounts held via partner banks. Yonder ships a consumer mobile app and a help centre but does not expose a public developer API or portal. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (backers include Northzone, Seedcamp and Techstars).

providers.name: ironSource
providers.description: ironSource is a Tel Aviv-based mobile game growth platform, acquired by Unity Technologies in a $4.4B all-stock deal that closed in November 2022 and is now operated as part of Unity's Grow Solutions group. The company builds an end-to-end suite for mobile game developers spanning ad monetization, user acquisition, and ad operations. Its flagship product LevelPlay is a unified in-app bidding and ad mediation platform that brokers Rewarded Video, Interstitial, and Banner ad demand across the ironSource Ads network, AdMob, AppLovin, Meta Audience Network, Pangle, Mintegral, Unity Ads, Vungle, and dozens of other ad sources. ironSource Ads is its self-serve ad network and user-acquisition platform offering CPI, CPE, ROAS-optimized, and SKAdNetwork-aware campaign management. Adjacent products include Aura (an on-device content marketplace for carriers and OEMs that originated from the 2021 Bigabid/Soomla portfolio and earlier hardware OEM deals), Tapjoy Offerwall (acquired 2022) for rewarded engagement, and Ad Quality for ad-content monitoring. Developer access is via a REST surface hosted at platform.ironsrc.com — including the Monetization Reporting API (v5/v4), ironSource Ads Reporting API, Application API (v6), Campaign API suite (Campaigns, Audiences, Country Groups, Bidding, Assets, Creatives), SKAN Reporting API, and Cost API — authenticated with Bearer tokens issued from the platform dashboard. Real client integration is delivered via native SDKs (iOS, Android, Unity, Flutter, React Native, Adobe AIR, Xamarin) plus the LevelPlay mediation adapter ecosystem published on github.com/ironsource-mobile. As of 2026 the developers.is.com knowledge center 301-redirects to docs.unity.com, consolidating ironSource documentation inside Unity Grow alongside Unity Ads. No public OpenAPI, Postman collection, or JSON Schema bundle is published by ironSource for the REST surface; documentation is human-readable HTML on docs.unity.com/en-us/grow.

providers.name: OpenX
providers.description: OpenX is an independent supply-side platform (SSP) and programmatic ad exchange headquartered in Pasadena, California, founded in 2008. OpenX connects publishers and app developers to advertiser demand through a real-time marketplace that runs OpenRTB-based auctions across display, video, CTV, native, and mobile inventory. Its product suite is organized around the OpenX Exchange (the core marketplace), OpenXSelect (curation, deal creation, and supply-path targeting), OpenXBuild (a software toolkit for assembling custom supply-side workflows and real-time bidstream integrations), and OpenXControl (publisher yield management and demand routing). OpenX exposes several developer-facing APIs documented at docs.openx.com — an OpenRTB API for DSP bidding integrations, a Platform API for account, inventory, demand, targeting, and deal management, a Reporting API for analytics and performance metrics, an OpenXSelect GraphQL API for managing audiences/deals/inventory lists, and an OpenXBuild Real-Time Bidstream API — but the references are gated behind OAuth and OpenX does not publish a public OpenAPI specification or Postman collection. The company is a major contributor to the Prebid.org header-bidding ecosystem (Prebid.js and Prebid Server) and maintains a large GitHub organization with OAuth-based API client libraries in Python, PHP, Java, Perl, and Ruby for the legacy OX3 API. OpenX's business model is transaction-fee based — it takes a share of each ad impression cleared through its exchange — and access to the developer APIs requires an active OpenX account and BD/account-management onboarding rather than self-service signup.

providers.name: Wellxai
providers.description: Wellx (Wellxai) is a Dubai-based health insurtech company that transforms health insurance from reactive to proactive through AI-driven behavior change. Its consumer mobile app pairs behavioral science and gamification with wearable integrations (Fitbit, Apple Watch, Whoop) so members earn xCoins rewards by hitting health goals, step and sleep challenges, and wellness programs, then redeem them with marketplace partners. Wellx also sells to corporates and SMEs and partners with brokers and insurers, positioning healthier behavior as the driver of better-value health insurance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company exposes consumer iOS/Android apps backed by a private API but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Jupiter Money
providers.description: Jupiter Money is a Bengaluru-based Indian digital banking app (neobank) operated by Amica Financial Technologies Private Limited. Founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta, Jupiter delivers a consumer "money app" experience that bundles savings and salary accounts, UPI payments, co-branded credit cards, personal loans, mutual funds, digital gold, fixed and recurring deposits, insurance, and a Jewels rewards program into a single mobile application. Jupiter is itself not a bank — it operates as a fintech marketplace and Loan Service Provider on top of regulated partners. Federal Bank is the primary banking partner for savings, salary, and deposit products, with CSB Bank powering the Edge+ and Edge RuPay credit cards and Federal Bank the Edge Federal VISA card. Lending is provided through partners including Amica Finance Private Limited and Kisetsu Saison Finance, with mutual funds through AIAPL and digital gold through MMTC-PAMP. The product is consumer facing and distributed via the Android and iOS apps; Jupiter does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. All integrations with banks, NBFCs, NPCI/UPI rails, card networks, and depositories are private business-to-business arrangements rather than an open API program.

providers.name: KWI
providers.description: KWI is a retail technology company founded in 1985 and headquartered in Melville, New York, that delivers a cloud-based, unified commerce platform for specialty and department retailers. The platform combines an iOS mobile point-of-sale, merchandising and inventory optimization, order management with buy-anywhere / fulfill-from-anywhere fulfillment, CRM, clienteling and loyalty, the Snapshot real-time sales analytics application, and AI product image search, all operated as a SaaS managed service with helpdesk, hardware, and payments support. KWI describes an API layer in its platform architecture used to export data to third-party systems and channels --- CRMs, ERPs, SRPs, and supply chains --- alongside packaged connectors such as Shopify Connect and a Klaviyo connector. As of this profile KWI publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, or SDKs; integration is delivered through its professional-services organization under customer contract.

providers.name: WebinarJam
providers.description: WebinarJam is a live webinar platform for marketing, training, and sales events, while its sibling product EverWebinar provides automated and evergreen webinar replays. Both products share a REST API that lets integrators retrieve webinars, register attendees, manage registrants, and drive marketing automations. The WebinarJam/EverWebinar API uses an API key (requiring approval) included in request payloads, with separate base paths for each product family.

providers.name: DIVE studios
providers.description: DIVE Studios is a global K-entertainment media platform that produces original shows, podcasts, and short-form social content, reaching over 135M Gen Z and Millennial fans and 5B+ lifetime views. The company operates two commercial arms: DIVE Media, which sells advertising and branded content across its podcast, video, and social network, and DIVE Agency (DIVE X), which builds creator, influencer, and celebrity marketing campaigns for global brands connecting with K-culture audiences. It publishes an llms.txt describing its pages but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or portal. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Easel AI
providers.description: Easel AI is a Los Angeles based generative AI company building a consumer app and a partner-facing image generation platform. Its models turn a single selfie into photorealistic single and multiplayer avatars without any per-user AI training, and the same technology is packaged for commercial use as Fashion Photoshoot (AI models of any race or body type wearing any outfit), Fashion Try-On (shoppers upload a picture and see themselves in an outfit instantly), Ad Creator (personalized ad creative from one selfie plus a context image), and Product Photoshoot (products placed in any scenario). Easel ships a consumer iOS app and markets a Try-On API and ad-generation API to fashion brands, ad platforms, messaging apps, dating and social apps, and talent agencies monetizing digital IP. As of this pass the API surface is partner-gated and contact-sales only - there is no public developer portal, documentation, API reference, machine-readable specification, or self-serve signup published on the website. Easel appears on the a16z investment list.

providers.name: Happy World
providers.description: Happy World operates SPICE (getspice.com), a premium lifestyle dining and rewards mobile application based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SPICE lets diners discover curated partner restaurants across the Kingdom, reserve or walk in, pay their bill in-app by entering the bill number, and earn instant cashback rewards (advertised as up to 20% cashback with no caps) on every visit. The product emphasizes intelligent personalization and a hand-picked selection of the best restaurants, food, and dining experiences. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a consumer mobile-app business with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: LAP Coffee
providers.description: LAP Coffee (Life Among People) is a Berlin-founded specialty coffee retail chain operated by Micro Retail Technologies MRT GmbH. It opened its first store in Berlin Mitte in August 2023 and has grown to a network of neighbourhood cafes across Berlin, with further locations and openings in Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg. LAP serves locally roasted specialty coffee at everyday prices from small, high-throughput stores, and runs a consumer mobile app (LAP: Everyday Coffee) for pre-ordering, in-store pickup, a stamps and rewards loyalty program, gifting and referrals, replacing an earlier Apple/Google Wallet stamp pass. LAP is backed by HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass LAP publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or developer documentation; its technology surface is the consumer app, the order.lap.coffee deep-link service and a Webflow marketing site.

providers.name: LendUp
providers.description: LendUp was a San Francisco consumer-lending fintech founded in 2011 and backed by GV and QED Investors, offering single-payment and installment loans to subprime borrowers alongside a gamified "LendUp Ladder" program that promised cheaper credit and credit-bureau reporting as borrowers repaid. LendUp Loans LLC ceased lending operations in January 2022 following Consumer Financial Protection Bureau enforcement actions over misleading marketing and pricing claims. The lendup.com domain is now operated by an unrelated company, LendUp LLC of Dover, Delaware, which runs a consumer loan-matching and financial-education site connecting borrowers to licensed lenders for a referral fee; it states it has no corporate, ownership, or operational relationship to the former lender and no access to its customer data. Neither entity publishes a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or any machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: RetainIQ
providers.description: RetainIQ is a full-service retention-marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, delivering lifecycle email and SMS programs. Its work spans automated flows (welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, replenishment), weekly strategic campaign sends with design and copywriting, and deliverability/segmentation/list-hygiene infrastructure. A proprietary 1:1 personalization engine generates variant product blocks at scale. A Klaviyo Gold Master Partner and Omnisend partner, RetainIQ integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Omnisend; plans start at $990/mo on month-to-month terms. It operates as a marketing-services agency and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Topline Pro
providers.description: Topline Pro is an AI-powered business management platform for local and home service professionals in the United States — contractors, landscapers, painters, roofers, cleaners, and other owner-operated service companies. It provides AI-generated websites, local marketing and online discovery, lead capture with automated follow-up, AI-assisted customer communication, appointment and job scheduling, and invoicing with automated payment collection. Topline Pro is backed by Forerunner Ventures and Northzone. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, gRPC, AsyncAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface; it does publish an llms.txt at its marketing domain that describes the platform for AI agents.

providers.name: Bluma
providers.description: Bluma is a San Francisco-based AI company (Y Combinator Fall 2025) building a short-form AI content engine that lets creators, agencies, and brands produce social media video ads at scale. The platform "de-edits" existing reference videos into their individual scenes, captions, and overlays, then uses AI asset generation and a node-based canvas editor to recreate and remix shots into new ads, UGC, and template-based videos optimized for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Bluma also publishes a set of free, browser-based social tools (video downloading, carousel/slideshow extraction, TikTok/Instagram URL normalization, metadata inspection, transcript generation, audio extraction, thumbnail capture). Founded by Alisa Wu (formerly Zoox/Amazon) and Stephen Ni. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Goomp Inc, Kalendar AI
providers.description: Kalendar AI (Goomp Inc / Kalendar Inc, a Delaware corporation operating from New York) is an autonomous AI sales-agent platform that automates B2B outbound prospecting end to end. It sources ideal-customer prospects from a database of hundreds of millions of professionals and companies, generates and sends personalized outreach through dedicated AI-managed mailbox infrastructure, qualifies replies, and books meetings directly onto the user's calendar. The product is sold as a self-serve, per-agent subscription and connects to common CRMs, calendars, and productivity tools. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Kalendar AI publishes a marketing site and product app behind Cloudflare, legal (terms/privacy) and sign-in pages, but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documented webhook surface.

providers.name: Ground AI
providers.description: Ground (joinground.com) is an AI-native revenue platform for consumer and e-commerce brands, delivering autonomous "AI revenue agents" that drive growth across the customer lifecycle. Its products include Greet AI for converting new visitors, ReBeat AI for repeat purchases and retention, and Terra, an AI-native revenue engine that orchestrates actions across the funnel. Ground positions itself as Growth-as-a-Service, plugging into a brand's existing stack (Shopify, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Recharge, Salesforce, Meta, Google Ads and 20+ platforms) with a fast, low-lift deployment. Headquartered in New York and Silicon Valley with a global team, Ground is a Techstars-backed company. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation at this time.

providers.name: iContact
providers.description: iContact is an email marketing and marketing automation platform (now part of Cision) that helps small and mid-market businesses build email campaigns, manage contacts and lists, automate drip sequences, and measure engagement. The iContact REST API v2.2 provides programmatic access to contacts, lists, segments, campaigns, messages, and reporting data using a combination of HTTP headers (API-AppId, API-Version, API-Username, API-Password) for authentication.

providers.name: Imagine Ai
providers.description: Imagine AI (YC F25) is a San Francisco B2B content platform, founded in 2025 by Neo Lee and Sky Yang, that reverse-engineers modern B2B growth starting with LinkedIn. It builds a persona-driven AI clone of a founder or executive by deeply analyzing their writing, speaking style, and market context, then uses that persona to plan content strategy, write LinkedIn posts, draft comments and DMs, and schedule coordinated distribution across an executive team (CEO, VP of Sales, Head of Marketing) from a single shared content calendar. Each client is paired with a dedicated content engineer, and the platform tracks engagement-quality analytics and inbound lead generation; early customers include MongoDB, Rippling, and Conduit. Imagine AI is a sales-led SaaS with no public self-serve developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition as of this catalog entry — this profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Makrwatch
providers.description: Makrwatch is a creator representation and sponsorship management platform that sits between independent content creators and brands. It sources and filters brand-deal opportunities, negotiates terms and rates, protects creator IP and creative freedom, and handles the administrative work of briefs, timelines, revisions, invoicing, and payment tracking so creators can focus on producing content. Founded out of Y Combinator (W15) and based in New York City, the platform reports $27M+ distributed to creators across 34,000+ sponsorships for 7,400+ creators operating in 118 countries. Makrwatch does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Mentimeter
providers.description: Mentimeter is a Swedish audience-engagement and interactive-presentation platform used to run live polls, quizzes, word clouds, ranking, open-ended questions and Q&A during meetings, classrooms and events, with results updating in real time as participants respond from their phones. Founded in Stockholm in 2014, it is used across education and enterprise for interactive presentations and workshops. Mentimeter does not publish a public developer REST API; its extensibility surface is delivered through LMS integrations (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace via LTI), presentation add-ins (PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams, Zoom) and SSO, rather than a documented HTTP API. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline against its public developer, security and trust surface.

providers.name: Mob.ly
providers.description: Mob.ly (Mobly) is an AI-powered event marketing platform — "The Event Marketer's Operating System" — that helps B2B go-to-market teams plan events, capture and enrich leads in person, engage prospects, and measure pipeline across trade shows and in-real-life (IRL) marketing experiences. Its product suite spans lead Capture, event Host, Insights reporting, Pulse, and Scout, with native integrations into HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, and generic webhooks. As of this enrichment pass Mobly operates a customer-facing web application (hub.getmobly.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Multiply
providers.description: Multiply is an AI-native media agency built specifically for B2B companies, pairing human paid-media strategists with a fleet of 25+ specialized AI agents to run and continuously optimize LinkedIn and Google Search advertising. Its "Self-Learning Advertising" platform plugs into a company's own data — sales call recordings (e.g. Gong), CRM closed-won outcomes, case studies, website content, competitive kill sheets and product documentation — and runs hundreds of structured ad experiments that refine audiences, copy and creative from real revenue signals. Multiply is a managed service (not a self-serve API product), founded by Matt Jayson (ex-Google, ex-Brex) and Ashish Warty (ex-HackerOne SVP Engineering, ex-Dropbox), and raised $9.5M led by Mayfield in March 2026. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Mayfield portfolio company; this pass confirmed it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Pimento
providers.description: Pimento is an AI ad-creative platform that helps marketing and advertising teams generate, analyze, and benchmark advertising creatives at scale. Its published product surface spans creative generation (Create), performance analysis (Analyze), competitive benchmarking (Benchmark), reusable brand kits, a Meta Score for predicting ad performance, multiformat output, and Meta Advantage+ support. Pimento is a venture-backed company in Partech's portfolio. As of this profile it publishes a marketing and product website with signup, login, and book-a-demo flows, but no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or MCP surface was found.

providers.name: Revnu
providers.description: Revnu is an AI-powered growth-automation platform for early-stage and technical founders, positioning itself as an "AI growth hire" that runs marketing work across channels so builders can stay in the codebase. The platform finds and qualifies leads from real signals, drafts cold outbound and partnership pitches, writes SEO content, runs paid ad experiments across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, and TikTok, turns product wins into short-form video and social posts, and tests pricing and landing-page copy, sending approvals and weekly recaps through iMessage, Slack, and email. Founded in 2026 out of the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch and based in San Francisco, Revnu is a SaaS product with a dashboard/agent interface rather than an API-first platform; it currently publishes no public developer API, but does expose machine-readable llms.txt context files for AI agents.

providers.name: Zoomin
providers.description: Zoomin is a content and knowledge orchestration platform that unifies unstructured product content — documentation, in-product help, knowledge base and community answers — into personalized self-service and in-app experiences across customer support, success and experience teams. Founded in Tel Aviv, Zoomin was acquired by Salesforce on November 1, 2024 and now powers the Unified Knowledge and Agentforce/Data Cloud offerings. Its products include the Content Delivery Platform, Documentation Portal, In-Product Help, Zoomin for ServiceNow, Unified Knowledge and Zoomin Analytics. Zoomin does not publish a public, self-serve developer API surface; its integrations are delivered through customer implementations and the Salesforce platform. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: FlyteDesk
providers.description: flytedesk is the campus advertising platform that connects national brands with college media across the United States. Founded in 2015 in Boulder, Colorado, it operates the largest network of campus media in the US, letting advertisers create, book, manage, and measure national campaigns across print, digital, email newsletters, social, influencer, radio, and out-of-home channels reaching millions of college students. For college publishers and campus media organizations, its self-serve platform provides tools to build, manage, and monetize their media ecosystem, along with an Audience Builder for targeting. flytedesk is backed by Techstars. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web presence and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pinoffer
providers.description: Pinoffer is the API Evangelist network profile for Converted (convertedin.com), a MENA-focused adtech and martech "unified growth platform" operating across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE. Founded by Mohamed Fergany, Mohamed Atef, and Mustafa Raslan, and backed by 500 Global, Converted helps 10,000+ businesses in emerging markets manage marketing data, ad payments, lead generation, and order intelligence across Google, Meta, TikTok, and other channels through a single interface. Its products include Converted Pay (ad credit, local invoicing, and spend policies), Flyerz, Leads, and Orders. Converted is a Google Premier Partner and a Deloitte Fast 50 company. As of this enrichment pass Converted publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK program; this profile is identity-and-domain-security only.

providers.name: Bikky
providers.description: Bikky is a New York-based Customer Data Platform (CDP) built exclusively for large, multi-unit restaurant brands, serving thousands of locations for companies such as Bojangles, MOD Pizza, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Long John Silver's. By integrating with point-of-sale, online ordering, payment, and loyalty systems, Bikky builds a single source of truth on guests, cleaning, standardizing, and de-duplicating data to reveal behavior, frequency, lifetime value, and menu performance across channels. Bikky offers push-button API integrations with leading ordering, loyalty, and marketing providers, plus Snowflake data shares, SFTP, and CSV import for data exchange. It does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API or documentation; integration and data access are arranged directly with Bikky.

providers.name: Clay
providers.description: Clay is a go-to-market platform that combines people and company data enrichment from 150+ premium providers, AI research agents (Claygents), intent signals, and workflow automation for sales, marketing, and revenue operations teams. Clay exposes inbound HTTP API endpoints and webhooks so external systems can push records into Clay tables, trigger enrichments, and receive enriched data for CRM sync, lead scoring, and outbound workflows.

providers.name: Rubicon Project
providers.description: Rubicon Project is a Los Angeles-based advertising technology company, founded in 2007, that built and operated one of the largest real-time bidding advertising exchanges, connecting digital publishers (the sell side) with advertisers and demand-side platforms. In 2020 Rubicon Project merged with Telaria and rebranded as Magnite, now positioned as the world's largest independent sell-side (SSP) advertising company, spanning connected TV (CTV), online video, display, and audio across its DV+, SpringServe, and ClearLine platforms. This profile tracks the company as it exists today under the Magnite brand. Rubicon Project / Magnite publishes no public self-serve developer API or documentation portal — platform access is enterprise and partner-gated through the Magnite Help Center.

providers.name: Sweatcoin
providers.description: Sweatcoin is a health-and-fitness app that converts a user's physical steps and movement into a digital currency ("sweatcoins") that can be redeemed for gadgets, subscriptions, travel vouchers, charity donations, and cryptocurrency. Its proprietary movement-validation algorithms count outdoor steps while, the company states, not selling location data. Sweatcoin reports being a top-3 health & fitness app worldwide with tens of millions of users across 180+ countries, and partners with brands and organizations (NHS, Apple, Amazon and 600+ others) through sponsored challenges, clubs, boosts and an affiliate marketplace. The team also launched the Sweat Economy ($SWEAT), a NEAR-Protocol "movement economy" token, and the Sweat Wallet app, turning tracked movement into on-chain digital value. Sweatcoin exposes no public REST/OpenAPI developer surface; integration is via partner and marketplace programs and the SWEAT on-chain token.

providers.name: TVbeat
providers.description: TVbeat is a London-based, Techstars-backed advertising technology company whose platform unifies linear television and streaming (CTV) advertising operations into a single system. It lets media owners and buyers forecast, plan, transact, optimize, and measure campaigns across audiences, yield, and operations, supporting multi-currency transacting (ratings, spots, impressions, and outcomes) and modern buying models — Direct, Programmatic, Self-Serve, and AI-driven — across both traditional linear spots and streaming inventory. TVbeat does not publish a public API, SDK, or open developer portal; its documentation portal at docs.tvbeat.com is private and requires credentials.

providers.name: West Technology Group
providers.description: West Technology Group is a cloud-based global technology company providing customer experience and communications solutions through its WestCX platform. The company operates through two main brands: Mosaicx, which delivers AI-native conversational automation for enterprise customer engagement, and TeleVox, which provides digital patient engagement solutions for healthcare organizations including providers, payers, and life sciences companies.

providers.name: MIDAS Technologies
providers.description: Midas (Midas Technologies / Midas Inc.) is a free consumer cash-rewards and loyalty app in Mexico, built around the slogan "Tu efectivo cuenta" (your cash counts). Shoppers earn points worth up to 5% back when paying at affiliated merchants, where one Midas point equals one Mexican peso and accumulated points can be spent to pay the full total of a bill at participating stores. The app lets users create an account in under three minutes with just a name and phone number, view their points balance, browse promotions and discounts, find nearby affiliated stores on an interactive map, and track a full history of transactions and purchase tickets. Merchants can affiliate their business ("Afilia tu negocio") to reward customers. The company is a consumer-facing mobile app and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Art19
providers.description: Art19 (ART19, Inc.) is a podcast hosting, distribution, and monetization platform, and an Amazon company. It provides publishers, networks, and enterprises with a content management system for audio, automated RSS feed generation, dynamic ad insertion and targeting through its WarpFeed feed technology, and an embeddable Web Player. The platform serves podcast delivery, analytics, and advertising workflows at scale. Art19 does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its public presence consists of a marketing site, a contact page, a privacy policy, and a system status page tracking CMS, RSS, WarpFeed, and Web Player availability.

providers.name: Infusionsoft (Keap)
providers.description: Infusionsoft, now branded as Keap, is a sales and marketing automation CRM built for small businesses that combines contact management, email marketing, e-commerce, pipeline automation, appointments, and invoicing in a single platform. Keap exposes REST APIs (v1 and v2) and a legacy XML-RPC API for managing contacts, companies, opportunities, orders, products, tags, emails, and campaigns, all authenticated via OAuth 2.0 authorization code and refresh token grants.

providers.name: Jack in the Box
providers.description: Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK), founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a quick-service restaurant company operating and franchising approximately 2,200 Jack in the Box hamburger restaurants across 21 U.S. states. In December 2021 the company acquired Del Taco for $575M; in August 2025 it announced a strategic review of Del Taco and on October 2025 agreed to divest Del Taco (~600 locations) to Yadav Enterprises for $115M, with the transaction closing December 22, 2025. Digital channels include the Jack in the Box mobile app, Jack Pack loyalty program, online ordering, and integrations with third-party delivery platforms (DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats). The company does not publish a public developer API; all digital ordering, loyalty, and franchise systems are operated via internal platforms and partner integrations.

providers.name: Lifemote
providers.description: Lifemote Networks is an Istanbul-based provider of AI-driven home Wi-Fi analytics and experience management for broadband ISPs and network operators. A software agent running on the subscriber gateway or access point streams detailed in-home Wi-Fi performance telemetry to Lifemote's cloud, which scores quality of experience per household and per device and isolates root causes such as poor coverage, misplaced repeaters, congested or co-channel Wi-Fi, legacy client devices, and non-Wi-Fi interference. Operators consume the results through a web application for first-line support, proactive maintenance, churn detection and mesh/gateway upselling, plus quarterly expert-reviewed QoE reports. Lifemote markets a full-featured API for integrating this data with in-house OSS/BSS systems and support workflows, but that API is sold and provisioned through direct enterprise engagement — there is no public developer portal, documentation site, machine-readable specification, or self-service sign-up. Customers named publicly include A1, Community Fibre, Online.nl, and Tusass.

providers.name: Polymorph
providers.description: Polymorph is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building adaptive consumer internet infrastructure that personalizes user experiences with AI agents. Founded in San Francisco by Andrew Sy, the platform runs thousands of continuous product and lifecycle-engagement experiments for its customers, each carrying the craft of that product's direction and brand, so consumer teams can scale experimentation in product surfaces without being bottlenecked by headcount or design capacity. Its stated vision is to make the consumer internet polymorphic — one that adapts to each user and optimizes for delightful experiences. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site only; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Alpharank
providers.description: Alpharank is a no-code sales guidance and digital-origination analytics platform for banks and credit unions. It analyzes funded loan and deposit applications to reveal which marketing tactics, channels, and campaigns actually drive funded dollars, then guides institutions to optimize their online branch, curb funnel abandonment, and turn ad spend into higher-quality leads. Its products include Optimizer, AdSync, and CRMSync, and it serves roughly 200 financial institutions nationwide. Originally recognized for turning payment transaction data into customer influence graphs, Alpharank is a 500 Startups / 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Alpharank publishes a marketing and client-login presence but no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Disconetwork
providers.description: Disco (disconetwork.com) is a commerce media network focused on the post-purchase moment. It helps ecommerce brands monetize their order-confirmation and thank-you pages by placing relevant partner offers in front of shoppers, and gives advertisers a channel to reach buyers at the point of purchase. Its products span offer placement, audience insights, and cross-brand advertising across the post-purchase experience and beyond. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Hungryroot
providers.description: Hungryroot is a personalized grocery and meal-planning service that blends meal-kit convenience with grocery-store variety. Its AI-driven personalization engine builds each customer's cart from dietary preferences, health goals, and budget, drawing on a catalog of 50,000+ recipes and curated grocery products that support high-protein, gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary needs. Hungryroot is a direct-to-consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a consumer web and mobile app experience rather than a public developer platform. This profile was surfaced through the venture portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which probed the provider's domain and public discovery surfaces (no public API, OpenAPI, SDKs, well-known catalog, security.txt, or llms.txt were found as of this pass).

providers.name: Kelvin
providers.description: Kelvin (kelvin°) is a Paris-based startup, founded in 2023 and backed by Seedcamp, building an AI-powered commercial platform for the home energy-renovation industry in France. Its tools help RGE-certified artisans, renovation contractors, general contractors, CEE delegatees and trade platforms find and qualify renovation prospects, generate leads through embeddable address-based simulators, automatically compute energy-efficiency scenarios and government aids (MaPrimeRenov / CEE) with remaining customer cost, and assemble complete financing packages. The AI is trained by thermal engineers and architects and uses open data plus computer vision to assess buildings without a recent DPE. More than 4,000 artisans and sales reps use Kelvin to prospect, prepare appointments and quote work.

providers.name: Rank Science
providers.description: RankScience (RankScience LLC) is a San Francisco based SEO and AI-visibility agency that turns search rankings into revenue for startups, SaaS companies, and enterprises. Refined over 15+ years, its practice spans foundational and technical SEO, on-page and local SEO, strategic link building, and content strategy, plus a next-generation AI-visibility line covering generative engine optimization (GEO), large language model optimization, and answer engine optimization for platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. It serves technology, healthcare, legal, and specialized verticals with revenue-focused reporting. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; RankScience is an agency and publishes no public API, though it does publish an llms.txt for AI-agent discovery.

providers.name: Chord
providers.description: Chord is a New York / Santa Barbara-based commerce data and AI platform founded in 2021 by Bryan Mahoney (CEO) and Henry Davis (President & Chairman), both former Glossier executives. Chord began as a headless commerce backbone built on top of Solidus — the open-source Spree Commerce fork written in Ruby on Rails — and has since evolved into an AI-native commerce data platform with three layers: a Data Foundation that unifies sources such as Shopify, ad platforms, and CDPs; a Context Stack that grounds AI in store-specific business context; and a set of Agents that take action across the commerce stack. Its current product surface includes Chord OMS (a Solidus-based order management system covering orders, products, promotions, subscriptions, affiliates, gift cards, returns, shipping, tax, and digital products documented at chord.stoplight.io), Chord CDP (customer data platform with identity resolution, RFM scoring, customer lifetime revenue, and destination activations), Chord Event Tracking (client- and server-side eventing with Shopify Web Pixel integration and consent management via OneTrust and Shopify Customer Privacy API), Chord Data Platform (analytics, predictive modeling, attribution, recommendations, Fivetran ingestion, GA4 compatibility), and Chord AI / Copilot Chat, powered by Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.5 for SQL generation, Haiku 4.5 for response generation and classification) with charts, monitors, context modeling, and natural-language data querying.
