Chord's GitHub org (github.com/chordcommerce) maintains a fleet of Solidus extensions (solidus_stripe, solidus_braintree, solidus_paypal_braintree, solidus_subscriptions, solidus_virtual_gift_card, solidus_importer, solidus_avatax_certified), a consent-manager TypeScript library, a Jitsu fork for event ingestion, and example repos for eventing and analytics. Notable customers include Sonos, Blue Bottle Coffee, Rodan + Fields, MrBeast, and Ritual. Funding has come from M13 Ventures, Equal Ventures, Act One Ventures, Chingona Ventures, and CEAS Investments, with an $18M Series A reported by TechCrunch in 2021. The commercial model is sales-led with custom enterprise pricing gated behind a demo request.

providers.name: Flipp (Wishabi)
providers.description: Flipp (operated by Wishabi) is a Toronto-based retail media and digital merchandising company that connects retailers, brands, and consumers through shoppable digital experiences. Its consumer app aggregates weekly digital flyers, coupons, and shopping lists from more than 2,000 retailers including Walmart, Kroger, Home Depot, CVS, and Publix, helping shoppers find local deals and clip offers to loyalty cards. For businesses, Flipp runs a retail media platform - content collection, curation, and distribution of "full fidelity" shoppable merchandising experiences reaching over 100 million high-intent households - plus sponsored video and shoppable-item ad solutions built on 400B+ intent-based shopping signals. Flipp publishes no public developer API or portal; this profile captures the company's public web, merchant, and open-source (github.com/wishabi) surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Futuredontics
providers.description: Futuredontics is the parent company of 1-800-DENTIST, a dental marketing and patient-acquisition business with more than 38 years serving dental practices across the United States. Its core offerings are PatientLeads, a pay-per-call program that routes live new-patient calls (with AI-powered call screening) to practices on month-to-month terms, and PatientActivator, patient-engagement software that automates appointment reminders, review requests, and reputation management. The company reports serving 5,000+ practices, handling roughly 70,000 calls per month, and scheduling over two million appointments through its platform. Futuredontics is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Ibotta
providers.description: Ibotta is a Denver-based consumer technology company (NYSE: IBTA) that operates a cash-back rewards platform and the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN), a digital promotions and retail-media network. Consumers earn real cash back on everyday purchases in-store and online through the Ibotta mobile app, browser extension, and connected retailer loyalty accounts. For brands, agencies, and retailers, the Ibotta Performance Network distributes digital rebates and promotions to more than 200 million shoppers across Ibotta's owned properties and a network of partner retailers and publishers (including Walmart, Dollar General, Family Dollar, and others). Ibotta was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GGV Capital. It does not currently publish a public, self-serve developer API or OpenAPI specification; its integrations are managed B2B partner onboarding into the Ibotta Performance Network.

providers.name: Lolli
providers.description: Lolli is a bitcoin and cash-back rewards company founded in 2018 by CEO Alex Adelman, on a mission to make bitcoin accessible to everyone. Through a browser extension, website, and mobile app, Lolli gives shoppers a percentage of their purchase back in bitcoin or cash when they shop online and in-store at 25,000+ merchants including Adidas, Microsoft, Ulta, and Kroger. Merchants pay Lolli for driving sales, and Lolli shares that commission with users as rewards paid into their Lolli wallet. The company reports having distributed over $10 million in bitcoin rewards and onboarded thousands of people into bitcoin for the first time. Lolli is a consumer product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of version-one-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Incentivio
providers.description: Incentivio is a Boston-based digital guest engagement platform for multi-unit restaurant brands, unifying online ordering, loyalty, marketing automation, and guest analytics into a single system. Its Incentivio Connect product is an AI-powered, API-first restaurant data platform that ingests data from POS, loyalty, mobile apps, web, and marketplaces, resolves it into a single persistent Guest ID, and scores guests for lifetime value, churn risk, visit frequency, journey stage, propensity-to-purchase, and offer sensitivity. The platform is BigQuery-native with a Star Schema data model, SOC 2 aligned with encryption at rest and in transit and RBAC, and pairs an API-first surface with reverse ETL to sync unified guest records back to existing CRM and ad platforms. Incentivio is built on modern APIs and offers deep partner integrations with POS, payments, delivery, and marketing systems such as Toast, Oracle Simphony, Square, SpotOn, and PAR Brink. Public, self-service developer API documentation does not appear to be available; integration and API access are handled through partnerships and enterprise onboarding (the Connect Enterprise tier markets dedicated API SLAs).

providers.name: GetCraft
providers.description: GetCraft is a Southeast Asian creative and content-marketing marketplace, headquartered in Indonesia and backed by 500 Global, that brands itself as "The Creative Industry's Premium Directory." It connects brands and agencies with a vetted network of freelance creators and production partners ("Crafters") for content, video, design, advertising, and marketing work, spanning a talent Directory, a Jobs board, Managed project services, and a Community. Its companion publication, MarketingCraft, is a bilingual (English/Indonesian) content hub of articles, events, tutorials, jobs, and research for marketers and creators. GetCraft exposes no public developer or API surface; this record is an identity/enrichment profile.

providers.name: Intella
providers.description: Intella is an enterprise Arabic AI company founded in 2021 and headquartered in the MENA region, building voice and customer-experience technology that natively understands 25+ Arabic dialects and cultural nuances rather than adapting generic global models. Its product suite includes Ziila (an AI voice agent for inbound/outbound conversations), intellaCX (conversation analytics for sentiment and churn), intellaMX (media translation and dialectal subtitling), and intellaVX (Arabic speech-to-text). Intella raised a $12.5M Series A led by Prosus and is backed by 500 Global, Hala Ventures, and Hearst, with partnerships including Visa and Jumia Egypt. The company is currently a sales-led enterprise vendor with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: SocialSign.in
providers.description: SocialSign.in is a guest WiFi marketing platform that turns venue Wi-Fi login into a customer-acquisition and engagement channel. When guests connect to free Wi-Fi through branded splash pages, the platform captures opt-in contact data (email, phone, profile), measures visit frequency and dwell time, and syncs profiles to CRM and email/SMS marketing tools to trigger targeted campaigns across retail, hospitality, sports and entertainment, healthcare, and commercial real estate venues. The company exposes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: SpareFoot
providers.description: SpareFoot is the largest online marketplace for finding and reserving self-storage units, owned by Storable (the same parent that owns the storEDGE and SiteLink property-management systems, cataloged separately at api-evangelist/storable). SpareFoot itself does not publish a developer portal, API reference, or self-serve API keys for third parties to call. Instead, storage facilities' pricing, unit availability, and promotions reach SpareFoot through one-way, partner-gated data-feed integrations built by property-management software vendors - Storable Edge (storEDGE), SiteLink Web Edition, Storable Easy, Self Storage Manager (E-SoftSys), eDOMICO, and DoorSwap - each of which pushes its own facilities' inventory into the marketplace and receives reservation/lead data back. No endpoint list, request/response schema, or authentication scheme for this feed mechanism is publicly documented; a facility operator or software vendor must go through SpareFoot/Storable's integrations team to be onboarded. This entry documents that access model honestly rather than fabricating an API surface.

providers.name: @Stake
providers.description: Stake (Stake Technologies, Inc., NMLS #2535498) operates the "Return on Rent" cash-back network for renters. Renters earn cash back on their rent payments, build credit history through on-time payments, unlock exclusive local deals, and access banking services including an FDIC-insured checking account and debit card provided through banking partner Midland States Bank. Co-founded by Rowland Hobbs and Jimmy Jacobson, the platform reports more than 550,000 homes in its network and over $50M in cash back earned by renters, averaging roughly $350 per renter annually. Stake is a consumer-facing fintech product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (surfaced under Battery Ventures).

providers.name: Spring Labs
providers.description: Spring Labs is an AI-native compliance and customer-experience platform for financial institutions, deploying autonomous AI agents that complete operational work rather than only surfacing insights. Its agents score customer-service calls, run 100% QA/QC review coverage, identify and file complaints, and (soon) automate the dispute lifecycle, alongside SummerGRC, an AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance product. Spring Labs targets sponsor banks, fintech lenders, enterprise banks, BaaS platforms, and debt-collection (ARM) organizations. Originally a blockchain-based data and identity company backed by Multicoin Capital, the firm has repositioned around applied AI for regulated financial operations. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes a marketing/product site but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Impactyn B.V
providers.description: Impactyn B.V is an AI-powered crowd-marketing platform that turns authentic user-generated video reviews into brand marketing assets. Based in Cairo, Egypt, Impactyn connects brands with real customers who record genuine video testimonials, letting businesses leverage user-generated video content to increase visibility, credibility, and engagement. The platform is delivered primarily through consumer iOS and Android mobile apps plus a partner/brand web console, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API or developer platform is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nectar Social
providers.description: Nectar Social is an AI "social operating system" for consumer brands — an AI-powered social teammate that manages online communities, performs real-time social listening and sentiment analysis, tracks influencers, and turns organic social engagement and DM conversations into measurable revenue across community, brand safety, commerce, influencer, social-selling, and analytics use cases. Founded in 2023 by Misbah and Farah Uraizee and based in Bellevue, Washington, the company raised $30M from Menlo Ventures, GV (Google Ventures), and True Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass Nectar Social ships a SaaS web application (app.nectarsocial.com) but does not publish a public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs.

providers.name: Upsight
providers.description: Upsight was a mobile analytics and marketing platform for apps and games — positioning itself as a "user lifecycle management platform" combining omnichannel analytics, integrated web and mobile marketing, ad optimization, and a DataMine SQL analytics product behind a single SDK for iOS, Android, tvOS, Unity, and Web. A Battery Ventures portfolio company, the platform is now defunct - upsight.com no longer resolves, the help.upsight.com developer docs survive only in the Internet Archive, and the GitHub org has been dormant since 2020, though the UpsightKit CocoaPods SDK and the doctor PyPI package remain published.

providers.name: Axamer
providers.description: Axamer is the company behind Menteo (menteo.ai), an AI-agent platform for restaurants and restaurant chains, focused on Latin America. Menteo deploys a team of specialized AI agents for marketing (WhatsApp and email campaigns), 24/7 WhatsApp order taking, loyalty and rewards programs, and customer service, integrating with existing POS systems, delivery platforms, and messaging channels to unify customer data and automate marketing, sales, and retention. Plans start from $149 USD/month with no long-term contract. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this pass Menteo publishes a public marketing site with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy but no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Slintel
providers.description: Slintel is a B2B sales and market intelligence platform that mines buyer and technographic signals — company firmographics, technology installs, psychographics, and buying-intent scores — to help revenue teams prioritize accounts and time outreach. Founded in 2016 and backed by Accel and Sequoia, Slintel was acquired by 6sense in 2021 and its data and API services are now consolidated into the 6sense Revenue AI platform. Slintel's programmatic surface (company identification, firmographics, lead scoring, and enrichment) is delivered through the 6sense API Portal rather than a standalone Slintel developer portal; this profile reflects that consolidation and captures the surviving public developer surface.

providers.name: Allset
providers.description: Allset is a food pickup and rewards platform (now part of SoundHound AI) that lets consumers order ahead from local restaurants and coffee shops for grab-and-go, curbside, or dine-in service while earning up to 15% cash back. Positioned as an alternative to third-party delivery marketplaces, Allset connects diners directly with participating restaurants across 100+ U.S. cities, and also runs Allset for Teams for corporate meal ordering. It is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with a restaurant partner program; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: BeReal
providers.description: BeReal is a French social media application that encourages authentic, unfiltered daily sharing through a two-minute random notification window in which users capture a moment using both the front and rear cameras simultaneously. Positioned as an alternative to curated, algorithmic social media, it emphasizes genuine connection over performance and explicitly excludes AI-generated content from the platform. Founded in France and acquired by mobile publisher Voodoo, BeReal operates a consumer mobile product with a help center and an advertising business, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced via a16z and Accel portfolio data and enriched with the provider's real public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CrownIT
providers.description: CrownIT (Crownit.in) is India's online market-research and consumer-insights platform, now acquired by Ipsos, the world's leading market research company. Operating as a full-stack agency, Crownit conducts online surveys and tracks purchase and consumption behavior via shopping bills and product photos submitted through its mobile app, applying machine learning and big-data analytics to deliver fast, accurate and comprehensive consumer insights to over 200 brands and enterprises across 40+ Indian cities. Backed by Accel and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile; Crownit runs a consumer rewards and survey application rather than a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only and has no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: digitaleseiten
providers.description: Digitale Seiten is a German online marketing company that operates a network of 28+ industry-specific business directories for craftspeople and local service providers (for example Elektriker.org, Klempner.org, Maler.org and Dachdecker.org). The platform lets tradespeople create free business listings, distributes regional customer inquiries and job requests to registered companies as leads, improves their search-engine visibility, and provides review-collection tools. According to the company it lists 869,000+ registered businesses and has matched 765,000+ job assignments. It is a B2B directory and lead-generation service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Ebbo
providers.description: Ebbo is an enterprise loyalty and promotional marketing technology company that helps brands build lasting customer relationships and grow revenue through engagement. Its platform powers paid, tiered, and engagement-based loyalty programs alongside promotional overlays such as sweepstakes, instant wins, contests, and user-generated-content campaigns, supported by real-time performance dashboards, purchase validation, and advanced privacy and security controls. Ebbo pairs this technology with full-service program design, creative, program management, data analytics, rewards sourcing, and customer service for brands including T-Mobile, Lowe's, and FULLBEAUTY Brands. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Firefly
providers.description: Firefly Systems Inc. is a data-first moving out-of-home (mOOH) advertising network that turns taxis, rideshare vehicles, and other mobility assets into digital and static advertising surfaces across 15+ major North American markets and several countries. Its network of tens of thousands of GPS-connected screens delivers geo-targeted, contextual, and programmatic digital out-of-home (DOOH) campaigns with advanced tracking, attribution, and measurement. Firefly offers digital and static car tops, full and partial car wraps, in-car TaxiTV, around-car activations, and experiential LED and hologram truck formats, and supports programmatic buying through its VIOOH integration. The company is backed by investors including 500 Global, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and GV (Google Ventures).

providers.name: Gist
providers.description: Gist is an AI brand-visibility and discovery platform built by ProRata (founded 2024) that helps publishers and advertisers stay visible, measurable, and monetizable inside generative AI experiences. It offers three products: Gist GEO (generative engine optimization for consistent organic visibility in AI answers), Gist Ads (paid brand amplification placed directly in AI search surfaces and premium environments), and Gist Answers (an embeddable, publisher-backed AI answer engine for on-site engagement and monetization). Gist positions itself as turning AI from a black box into a measurable, actionable channel for brands and content owners. Surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Karma Science
providers.description: Karma (Karma Science, karmanow.com) is a consumer shopping-assistant platform delivered as a browser extension and mobile app that helps people shop smarter. Founded in 2015, it serves roughly 6.5 million users with automatic coupon finding at checkout, price-drop and back-in-stock tracking, cross-retailer wishlists, and cash-back rewards across major merchants including Amazon, Apple, Nike, Target, and Nordstrom. The company also offers an Embedded Loyalty and partnerships program for retailers. Karma is a Kleiner Perkins-backed consumer company; as surfaced through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline it publishes consumer product surfaces (apps, help center, blog) but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Lucky Cart
providers.description: Lucky Cart is a French MarTech company specializing in retail media and smart commerce for grocery and consumer-goods retailers. It combines first-party transactional data with e-retail media, machine learning, and AI to power personalized shopper engagement, gamified promotions, and the monetization of retailer audiences at scale. Lucky Cart works with major French grocery retailers and CPG brands to activate transactional data into targeted advertising, loyalty, and measurable campaigns. The company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Moonscale
providers.description: Moonscale is an AI sales advisor platform that automates top-of-funnel sales conversations and lead qualification with AI-powered sales avatars. Its avatars pitch products, qualify inbound buyers, handle objections, book meetings, and follow up around the clock across websites, landing pages, emails, and apps, with support for 130+ languages and CRM connections to Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, and Clay. Moonscale markets a no-code, "no dev work required" deployment and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface. Backed by EQT Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company profile.

providers.name: ProGrad
providers.description: ProGrad (prograd.uk) is a UK-based consumer mobile app that lets users earn money by playing games and completing online tasks such as surveys and offers, positioning itself as a leading "make money" app in the United Kingdom. Users choose from a large catalogue of games and micro-tasks, accumulate rewards, and withdraw earnings to PayPal or Visa once they pass a minimum threshold. The company also publishes Gen Z insights and research alongside a consumer blog. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, ProGrad is a consumer-facing product with no public developer program, API portal, or programmatic surface at this time.

providers.name: RadiantGraph
providers.description: RadiantGraph is a healthcare engagement platform that turns fragmented health data into personalized member connections to improve clinical outcomes and reduce wasted spend. Its "Intelligent Personalization" product suite includes a Health Data Engine that ingests and enriches member records with 80+ social determinants of health, Smart Cohorts for identifying high-risk member groups, and Smart Spend for scoring members on clinical risk. The platform integrates with CRMs, contact centers, campaign engines, portals, and care-management systems, connecting claims data warehouses, clinical data repositories, and member-demographics sources. Backed by True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or SDKs were found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Scorpion
providers.description: Scorpion is an American marketing technology company that provides revenue-focused advertising, marketing, and software services to local and multi-location businesses in home services, legal, franchise, and healthcare verticals. Founded in 2001 by Rustin Kretz and headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah (with major operations in Valencia, California), Scorpion pairs done-for-you digital advertising and SEO with its own AI-driven platform. In 2024 it launched RevenueMAX, an AI marketing platform built on Scorpion AI that aligns marketing spend, intake, and long-term revenue, and in 2025 it introduced Scorpion Convert, an AI intake-and-conversion product that automates response, scheduling, and voice/messaging engagement for missed leads. Scorpion is a services-and-platform provider; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Session AI
providers.description: Session AI is an ecommerce AI platform that uses agentic decisioning to optimize promotions and customer experiences in real time. Its Session Marketing Agent predicts in-session visitor intent and behavior, then delivers personalized offers, nudges, and messages to maximize revenue, conversions, and profit margins for retail, travel and hospitality, and telecom brands. The platform integrates via tag managers (Google Tag Manager, Tealium), an SDK, server-to-server calls, and prebuilt plugins/cartridges, advertising sub-50ms decision latency, no PII collection, and SOC 2 aligned controls. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published (integration is arranged during onboarding).

providers.name: Sharechat
providers.description: ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian social media company that operates the regional-language social network ShareChat and the short-video entertainment app Moj. The platform lets users across 15+ Indian languages share posts, images, videos, shayari, quotes, and trending content through personalized feeds. ShareChat monetizes through a self-serve advertising platform (ShareChat Ads) offering campaign management, audience targeting, and brand partnerships across its social and short-video surfaces. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and other investors, the company is one of the largest homegrown social platforms in India. As of this profile, ShareChat exposes consumer apps and a self-serve ad manager but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or programmatic API surface.

providers.name: Slik
providers.description: Slik is a Latin American employee experience (PX) platform that helps organizations measure, analyze, and activate employee engagement in real time. Its Engagement module runs collaborator-journey surveys with real-time reporting, AI-prioritized improvement opportunities, people analytics and prediction, and leader action plans across the selection, onboarding, climate, and wellbeing touchpoints; its Performance module tracks cascading OKRs and continuous feedback outside annual review cycles. Slik distributes surveys and reaches employees through messaging channels including Slack, Google, Microsoft Teams, Workplace, and WhatsApp. Founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina and backed by 500 Global/500 Latam, AVP Ventures, and Vulcano Fund, the platform serves large enterprises such as Burger King, AXA, DHL, Starbucks, and Dole. Slik does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: SmartAsset
providers.description: SmartAsset is a financial technology company that runs the largest online marketplace connecting consumers with fiduciary financial advisors. Its SmartAdvisor matching service pairs more than 50,000 retail investors each month with up to three vetted advisors based on geography, investable assets, and preferences, while the SmartAsset Advisor Marketing Platform (AMP) delivers advisors a subscription stream of qualified referrals plus lead automation that syncs into their CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Wealthbox, Redtail, Zoho, Pipedrive, SmartOffice). SmartAsset also publishes a large library of consumer personal-finance calculators and editorial content across taxes, retirement, mortgages, investing, and banking. Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, SmartAsset is a lead-generation and media business and does not currently expose a public developer API.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.
